data.revised_prompt:
Create exactly one 2x2 sprite sheet for a redesigned Romi attack FX. Overall canvas 1024x1024, divided into four equal 512x512 cells in a 2 rows x 2 columns layout, but with NO visible grid lines, NO borders, NO text, NO numbers, NO arrows, NO UI, NO watermark. Background must be perfectly solid flat magenta #FF00FF across the entire image, including between cells. Exactly four FX frames only, each centered in its own cell, same visual scale and similar bounding box, generous magenta margin; no effect element crosses or touches a cell edge.

Subject: pure attack effect only, no character. Do NOT draw any character, face, eyes, tentacles, shell body, creature silhouette, or complete decorative nautilus shell. Avoid a full vortex flower. The effect reads as a fast sharp compact “spiral pressure slash” made from water and shell-energy: a spiral core drives a directional crescent shockwave from lower-left to upper-right.

Visual language and palette only: deep ocean blue, electric cyan, turquoise glow, violet rim light, glossy underwater highlights, pearl bubbles, aqua-white impact highlights. Clean HD 2D game sprite FX polish, crisp silhouette, energetic cute underwater fantasy lighting, high contrast cyan/blue/violet. Not pixel art.

Frame details:
Top-left cell, frame 1 ignition: small tight electric-cyan spiral core appears, two short violet-blue crescent strokes wrapping around it, a few small pearl bubbles being pulled inward, compact and centered.
Top-right cell, frame 2 launch: the spiral snaps into a diagonal shell-pressure slash; a bright cyan crescent blade sweeps from lower-left toward upper-right, compact spiral core at its lower-left base, thin violet rim sparks, dynamic but contained.
Bottom-left cell, frame 3 hit peak: brightest frame; sharp aqua-white impact ring opens around the diagonal slash, broken crescent shards, short water-pressure streaks, tiny star glints, compressed pearl bubbles bursting outward; still centered and contained.
Bottom-right cell, frame 4 dissolve: slash breaks into faint blue-violet crescent afterimages, small bubbles, fading spiral ripple, clean readable footprint, lower intensity.

Use glossy underwater highlights and shell-energy curves without forming a complete shell illustration. Maintain solid #FF00FF background.
